task: U15 stage-A alias-theme regression watchlist: cc-t3's U15 JAR v1 makes themeless launcher-aliases inherit the target activity's theme (AOSP). List the OTHER alias-launch keys besides fd-api, per-key judge how t20 changes (splash theme vs main-UI theme), and state which t20 shot should be what. Focus wikipedia + Fossify.
board_access: none (window4 may be running; not touched)

fix_under_watch.rule: AOSP: an <activity-alias> with no android:theme inherits the TARGET activity's theme. route-A today falls a themeless alias back to the APPLICATION theme (AppSchedulerBridge:793); the deployed U13 JAR logs the target theme via [B8-ALIASTHEME] but does not apply it. U15 JAR v1 applies it (launch.theme = target theme).

method.which_launches_are_aliases: [B5-ALIAS] ... ordinary=false  (ordinary=true = non-alias; log fires for every launch)
method.what_theme_changes: [B8-ALIASTHEME] '<target> theme re-resolved X -> Y' (X!=Y = changes) or 'theme unchanged (Y)' (no-op)

Excluding it -> exactly 8 that reach the window and change: wikipedia, fd-notes, fd-calendar, fd-filemanager, fd-gallery, fd-musicplayer, fd-organicmaps, fd-im-vector-app.

key_mechanism: Every target theme Y that differs from X is a SPLASH theme (AppTheme.Splash / SplashTheme / MwmTheme.Splash / SplashScreenThemeBase / Theme.Vector.Launcher). The target component carries the Android-12 SplashScreen theme and swaps to the real UI theme after first frame. So the fix governs the PRE-CONTENT (splash) window; a lit key's t20 steady-state (after splash dismiss) is unchanged.

watch_lit_splash_only.note: already LIT at t20; fix only re-skins the pre-content frame. t20 must stay the SAME lit UI. RED FLAG if t20 now shows a stuck splash (splash-dismiss broke on route-A).

wikipedia.u13_t20: LIT onboarding (globe + 全世界的知识)

neutral_blocked_upstream.note: the blocking wall is upstream of the theme; the fix does not light these. t20 unchanged.

fd-musicplayer.expected_t20: UNCHANGED home/crashed; splash may re-skin brief pre-crash frame only

control_noop.note: theme already == target (fix is a literal no-op). t20 must be byte-identical; ANY change here = a bug in the fix.

this_rounds_rule: An alias-theme fix is a SPLASH-theme fix: every target theme it applies is the launcher component's splash theme, which the app dismisses after first frame. So for a LIT key judge t20 as UNCHANGED (watch only for a stuck-splash regression), not as a new screen; the only t20 that should actually improve is the one whose wall WAS the theme (fd-api). Keys blocked by an upstream wall (Bitmap / Realm / mozglue) do not move, and theme-unchanged keys are the control that must stay byte-identical.
